generate.title: Generate Virtual Devices
generate.batchNoPlaceholder: Auto-generated; can be changed to a custom batch number
generate.rule1: Numbering rule: VD + date (yyMMdd) + 6-char random segment (digits 2-9 and uppercase letters excluding I/O)

generate.emptyResult: No device numbers generated, please retry

qr.title: Device Activation QR Code
qr.emptyDeviceNo: Device number is empty, cannot generate the QR code
qr.activatedWarning: Device is activated: re-scanning to activate will rotate the key and force the current online device offline. Proceed with caution.
qr.disabledWarning: Device is disabled: activation will fail. Enable the device first.
qr.unboundWarning: Device is not bound to a merchant: scan activation will fail. Bind a merchant first.
qr.scanTip: Scan with the virtual device APP to complete device binding; or copy the content below and enter it manually
qr.downloadFailed: QR code download failed, please retry

appConfig.title: Payment Broadcast
appConfig.broadcastHint: Broadcast the received amount on the store speaker after payment
appConfig.printHint: Print a receipt automatically after payment
appConfig.storeStrictHint: Push only to devices bound to the store
appConfig.storeStrictHintFull: When enabled, store orders are pushed only to devices bound to that store; devices without a bound store no longer participate. When disabled, devices without a bound store are treated as merchant-wide and receive all store orders.

exportFailed: Export failed. Please try again later.

bind.title: Bind Merchant
bind.appPlaceholder: Select an app (optional, defaults to the default app)
bind.storePlaceholder: Select a store (optional, general-purpose device of the merchant)
